subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/stream` plus `SessionEntry.streamingMode` as the shared MVP command/state shape for Telegram, Discord, and Slack after the suppression bugs and proof gap are fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing command, durable session state, and a channel capability; those are product/API decisions even if the remaining code bugs are mechanically fixable.

options.title: Accept the bounded MVP after fixes
options.body: Keep the `/stream` command, session field, and capability gate, but require consistent resolver/suppression behavior plus current-head channel proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the MVP
options.body: Limit the first merge to one or two channels or a smaller command shape if maintainers are not ready to commit to cross-channel semantics.

options.title: Reject the core command
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers decide preview streaming overrides should stay plugin/local or outside OpenClaw core for now.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded MVP after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the `/stream` command, session field, and capability gate, but require consistent resolver/suppression behavior plus current-head channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the shared channel streaming resolver and progress suppression surface points to vincentkoc.
